_comment: models/pick_cup_angle_182076 (job 182076, dataset pick_cup_angle). It came without a README; this layout is read from its normaliser stats: state = [left wheel angle since the run started, right wheel angle since the run started (+ = forward), -arm.abs_pos_deg, -gripper.abs_pos_deg]; action = [left wheel target angle, right wheel target angle, arm target, gripper target] on the state's scale. Its arm and gripper ranges equal pick_cup_pos2's with abs_pos_deg negated, and its action minus state averages pick_cup_pos2's degrees-to-go. Each wheel turns by target - measured angle.
